Ardent Keepers.name: Ardent Keepers
paras: The Ardent Keepers are the beastmasters and rangers of Faelindral, sworn wardens of Evershade Weald's ancient forests and surrounding lands. ; Their oath is to preserve the natural order between the beasts of the Weald and Faelindral, as well as protect the land from encroachment. ; They have organized with the Wyrdguard to combat the Fellstone orc incursion.

Deepcut Bandits.name: Deepcut Bandits
paras: The Deepcut Bandits are a faction working a mine -- the Deepcut -- on the North Gate East side.
Head east from the North Gate East area, past the wererat camp, until you reach the Deepcut bandit camps.
Outside the mine stand 5 to 8 camps, all of which spawn Deepcut bandits. Camps spawn in groups of 4 to 5.
The Deepcut appear in several roles, including A Deepcut miner, A Deepcut overseer and A Deepcut marksman.

Deepcut bandits drop a Deepcut Bandit's Hand. Six hands make a standing bounty -- see Deepcut Bandit Bounty for the full walkthrough. The hand-in goes to Traven Keldress, who issues a Deepcut Hand Bounty receipt to be redeemed with Elara Venn, the paymaster, at the East Docks Bounty Office.
* Belot -- spawns at any of the camps or inside the mine itself; sometimes with a summoned pet, sometimes without. * "Jeroth" (spelling unconfirmed) -- drops a head whose purpose is not yet known.
Beyond the camps. Only partly explored at time of writing; believed to open into several large rooms full of enemies.
10 to 16, and mostly group content rather than solo.
